title: Agie-only controls show for jobs that are not for the Agie control

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
## What happens

The maintainer reported that the "Export Agie inspection setup" text and button appear everywhere. Agie-only user interface shows for jobs that do not use the Agie control (AGIECUT CLASSIC 2S, AgieVision job files).

Places found on `main`:

1. Post page, section "Agie nominal inspection" (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/agie_inspection.rs:30`). The section draws for each setup. For a machine that is not the Agie machine, it shows "Mount the AGIECUT CLASSIC 2S machine on this setup to create an inspection opening." (`:39`). Each user sees this text.
2. Operation page, the action "Export Agie inspection setup" (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/op_page.rs:304-353`). It shows when `operation::has_agie_inspection_source(op)` is true. This needs a check: if the test is also true for an ordinary DXF wire operation, the action shows on normal wire jobs.
3. Wire page, an open cut (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/wire_page.rs:236-240`). The rows "Both pieces clamped…" and "Stock centered in installed XY travel" and the hint "Agie open cuts require both clamps…" show for each open cut, for each post. Only the Agie post reads these values (`crates/app/src/operation/agie_profile.rs:146`).
4. Other places that offer the Agie inspection import or export (browser and file menus) need the same check.

## What is expected

Agie-only controls and texts show only when the job is for the Agie control:

- The inspection section and the inspection import show only for a setup that mounts the Agie machine.
- The export action shows only for a real inspection operation on such a setup.
- The Agie-only rows of the Wire page show only for a job that posts with the Agie post.

For Agie users, the operation works as it does now. The commands and the MCP tools do not change.

## Not in scope

The name of the Agie post ("Native wire EDM job files") and its refusal texts are a separate question. A naming decision is open with the maintainer.

## Done means

- A setup with another machine shows no Agie section on the Post page.
- A normal DXF wire operation on another machine shows no Agie export action.
- An open cut for another post shows no Agie-only rows.
- An Agie setup still shows the section, and an inspection operation still shows the export action.
- Tests pin each of these cases.

The account that files this issue cannot set labels. A collaborator: please set P3, bug, effort:medium, area:ui, area:post and source:agent.
